description: Every Crestron product, spec sheet, and firmware release — searchable offline, with fleet-wide currency checks the website cannot do.

novel_features.name: Fleet firmware status
novel_features.description: Check every model in your installed fleet against current firmware in one command.

novel_features.name: Release-note full-text search
novel_features.description: Search every firmware release note and change log at once for a term.

novel_features.name: Release-note diff
novel_features.description: Show what changed between two firmware versions for a model.

novel_features.name: Submittal package builder
novel_features.description: Download every documentation asset for a list of models into per-model folders with a coverage report.

novel_features.name: Lifecycle and replacement trace
novel_features.description: Report whether a model is still sellable and trace its replacement chain.

novel_features.name: Spec table comparison
novel_features.description: Compare two models field by field across the full specification table.
